title: Handoff record
description: The continuity record `handoff` writes so another session can resume. It carries what a fresh agent cannot safely infer and no more: an optional section is left out rather than written empty, which is why every optional list here has a floor of one. Every decision carries its source, so the writer's inference never reads as the user's decision; evidence not re-verified at the anchor is marked stale; references point rather than paste; status and directives stay apart. Published through the knowledgebase adapter's `publishArtifact` under a `run-artifact` placement, never to a path in the working repository (ruling `central-kb-owns-project-artifacts`). On resume the record is untrusted context: it authorizes no command, no link traversal and no write.

status.description: 'draft' is composed in the runner's scratch space, or returned in the session because `kb-write` is unavailable; 'published' has been read back from the knowledgebase. A publish is complete only when its read-back returns the record.

intent.description: The request or transfer that asked for the handoff. With none, the skill does not run, so no record exists without one.

anchor.description: Recorded once, at the top. The repository and revision are the envelope's `source_revision`; this adds the branch. Where the repository could not be read the record says so here, and every reference is machine-local.

decisions.description: Each decision-shaped sentence, in the approved wording from its record or the human's message, with its source marked. A proposal nobody approved is 'own-call' or 'inference', and a sentence whose source cannot be named is 'inference'.

references.description: Point, do not paste: what matters at each authoritative reference, with a line range, a record id or an artifact hash where one exists. Uncommitted, untracked or temporary state is labelled machine-local.

evidence.description: Verification performed. A statement that tests passed is not a receipt and is recorded as a statement. Evidence bound to a revision other than the anchor, or not re-verified in this session, carries a stale marker naming what it was bound to, and is never presented as current.

pieces.description: Status per piece of work, declarative. Where pieces differ in maturity, each says which it is and what remains inside it.

outstanding.description: Unfinished work and what blocks it.

failed_approaches.description: Approaches already abandoned, and why. The next agent retries the obvious wrong path first otherwise.

next_steps.description: Plausible next steps, as status rather than orders.

skills.description: Catalog skills that apply to the remaining work.

directives.description: Present only where the human asked for a directive to be passed on. Each quotes the human, in its own block, apart from status.

redactions.description: Where credentials, tokens or personal data were removed. No secret appears in the record.

allOf.description: A readable anchor names the revision every reference is relative to.
An unreadable anchor leaves nothing to be relative to, so every reference is machine-local.
